methodology.scoringPrinciple: Each pillar is broken into measurable sub-criteria backed by repository files or static analysis outputs. Unmeasured behavioral or runtime criteria receive 0 points until an automated runner or captured runtime evidence file exists.
methodology.zeroCompensationGate: No documentation score may compensate for a P0 failure in artifact truth, runtime safety, or behavioral correctness.
activeZeroCompensationBlockers: P0-1: 30 of 48 SKILL.md files include 'Not Run' inside 'Artifact status:' in their Output schema block, contradicting the repository truth-state law where 'Not Run' is exclusively a Runtime state and 'Not Produced' is the default Artifact state.
P0-2: 0 automated behavioral or routing evaluation runners exist in the repository.

P0-3: scripts/export-claude-skills.mjs spawns external 'zip' binary on Linux/macOS and fails with ENOENT in minimal container environments; .github/workflows/docs.yml only runs 'npm run docs:check' rather than 'npm run ci'.

criteria.description: All 48 skills ship valid Anthropic/Claude.ai frontmatter (name <= 64, description <= 200, no extra keys)
criteria.evidence: 48/48 skills pass assertSkillFrontmatterSpecCompliant and assertSkillFrontmatterUploadLimits in scripts/check-docs.mjs.

criteria.description: All 48 skills contain complete template sections and consistent truth-state definitions
criteria.evidence: 40/48 skills include all 26 sections; 8 Batch 7/8 skills omit Decision tree, Playbooks, Failure handling, Troubleshooting, Best practices, Good/Bad examples, User-facing response template, and Anti-patterns. 30/48 skills list 'Not Run' under 'Artifact status:'.

criteria.description: Zero exact trigger phrase collisions and clear role boundaries
criteria.evidence: 191 distinct trigger phrases across 48 skills with 0 exact string collisions. Minor semantic overlap exists across the 4 routing skills.

criteria.description: Machine-readable input/output contract per skill (contract.json + generated registry)
criteria.evidence: Prose/table Input schema and Output schema sections exist in 48/48 skills, but 0 machine-readable contract.json files or registry/skills.json exist yet.

criteria.description: All 48 skills connected in workflow handoff graph with valid targets
criteria.evidence: 373 edges extracted across 48 skills; 100% of targets resolve to valid skill IDs. Zero skills have 0 outgoing edges.

criteria.description: Linear progression subgraph is acyclic and retry loops have explicit exit gates
criteria.evidence: 0 cycles in the 211-edge linear progression subgraph; 14 cycles exist in the full forward graph via retry/fallback/troubleshooting edges.

criteria.description: Consistent handoff notation and zero unreachable/orphan skills
criteria.evidence: Notation is split: 35 skills use relative paths (`../<id>/SKILL.md`) and 13 skills use bare IDs (`<id>`). `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` has 0 incoming forward progression edges (only 6 boundary_delegation edges).

criteria.description: Compiled workflow-graph.json with automated CI graph validator
